visibility.note: Every boundary is frozen as visible/occluded; hidden edges absent in the original are not added. Faces use explicit frozen painter order, never inferred line visibility.

ambiguities: The original does not show the back-face rope path; two nonbranching rear routes are possible. Do not infer or draw a unique hidden route. Exactly one offered option is compatible with a continuous rope and the180-degree axial rotation.
The wood is modeled as a thin extrusion of its given notched rounded outline, not assumed to be a circular cylinder. Thickness is a display construction and invisible in this face-on projection.
